attempts.answer:
The exact product and domain in question are **MooTools** at **mootools.net**.

There is no commercial operating company behind the product; it is an open-source project directly developed and provided by founder **Valerio Proietti** and the **MooTools Developers** (also known as the **MooTools Development Team**).

* **Provider Statement:** The official site footer across **mootools.net** (including the homepage and the `/developers` page) specifies:  
  > *"Copyright © 2006–2026. Valerio Proietti & MooTools Developers."*
